name: skilder
description: Connect any agent to a Skilder workspace: the roles, skills, tools and Apps its admins publish, served live over MCP and governed there.

interface.longDescription: Skilder is where a team builds, shares and governs the skills and tools its AI agents use at work. This plugin connects the agent to the team's Skilder workspace over MCP with a browser sign-in. The agent then starts each task with init_skilder, learns the role the workspace suggests, and runs that role's skills and tools through Skilder, with every call recorded against a session. Roles, skills, tools and Apps are served live by the workspace and never bundled here.
defaultPrompt: Use Skilder to find the role that fits this task and do it with that role's skills.
Use Skilder to show what roles and skills my workspace publishes.
